stage: A + B (source + model-intake coordinates, real transpose interface at entry/Schur/coordinate level, the archived P0-P3 factor rules over the reals, the two high roots' actual source rows, packet recipes and rejection transfers)
exact_domain: 2 < k <= 21/10, r > k, F = height >= gamma = 4132517/1000000 (actual, strict); r = k stays low branch

domain.HighRDomain: 2 < x 0 /\ x 0 <= 21/10 /\ x 0 < x 1 /\ gamma <= height x   (x 0 = k, x 1 = r on X22)
domain.HighRClosedDomain: 2 <= x 0 /\ x 0 <= 21/10 /\ x 0 <= x 1 /\ gamma <= height x   (the models' closed outer box)

F_is_height_not_two_r.height_extractX_eq: forall M, height (extractX M) = rX M - wX M   (F = r - w on the ACTUAL X22 point)
F_is_height_not_two_r.two_r_eq_height_iff: forall M, 2 * rX M = height (extractX M) <-> wX M = -(rX M)   (the 2r reading coincides only when w = -r, NOT assumed)
F_is_height_not_two_r.gamma_le_height_iff: forall M, gamma <= height (extractX M) <-> gamma <= rX M - wX M

actual_source_into_the_model_coordinates.extractX_highDomain: 2 < kX M -> kX M <= 21/10 -> kX M < rX M -> gamma <= rX M - wX M -> HighRDomain (extractX M)
actual_source_into_the_model_coordinates.highDomain_subset_closed: forall x, HighRDomain x -> HighRClosedDomain x
actual_source_into_the_model_coordinates.not_highR_of_r_eq_k: forall x, x 1 = x 0 -> not (HighRDomain x)   (r = k is low branch)

real_transpose_entry_level.transX: (transX M) i j = sgnD i * M j i * sgnD j with D = Q * J0 = diag(1,-1,1,-1,-1), Z = diag(1,-1,-1)
real_transpose_entry_level.Ghead_transX: Ghead (transX M) = GheadTranspose M, i.e. e_new * u0_new = beta * v0

stage_B_schur_transport.S4_transX: S4 (transX M) i j = J4 i * J4 j * S4 M j i
stage_B_schur_transport.S3_transX: S3 (transX M) i j = J3 i * J3 j * S3 M j i
stage_B_schur_transport.T2_transX: T2 (transX M) i j = J2 i * J2 j * T2 M j i
stage_B_schur_transport.cp1..cp4_transX: the four complete pivots transport (the index swap is a bijection, |J| = 1)
stage_B_schur_transport.satFrame_transX: SatFrame M -> SatFrame (transX M)   (all eleven fields paid)

stage_B_actual_coordinates.SX_transX: S_new = Z (S M)^T Z   (through D119 SX_eq_S4)
stage_B_actual_coordinates.OX_transX: O_new = Z (O M)^T Z   (through D119 OX_eq_entry, needs satFrame_transX)

interval_layer.BI: closed intervals with Mem/Empty; plus/minus/meet/times exactly as rankone_oracle.hpp
interval_layer.P3_rule: BI.not_mem_of_empty / BI.empty_contradiction: an empty contracted interval refutes every real point in it

packet_layer.Packet.Realizes: the three-conjunct realization predicate (own intervals, factor intervals, product intervals)

P2_multiplicative_cycle.graph: PVert (anchor/left/right), ppot (1, a_i, 1/b_j) and the six archived edge families PEdge (hiA/loA/hiB/loB/hiZ/loZ)
P2_multiplicative_cycle.PEdge.le_pot: every archived edge is a true constraint pot v <= pot u * w for strictly positive realizations
P2_multiplicative_cycle.Walk.one_le_prod: a closed constraint walk forces 1 <= product of its weights (the exact archived cycle criterion)
P2_multiplicative_cycle.not_realizes_of_cycle: a closed chain with weight product < 1 refutes every strictly positive realization - the P2 rejection certificate

model_dictionary.Gmodel: type I: G = e * beta; type II: G = e * u0 (the archived HEAD_TYPE)
model_dictionary.Gmodel_I_transX: type I's head product is transpose-invariant (e and beta are exchanged)
model_dictionary.Gmodel_II_transX: type II's head product becomes beta * v0 (G = e_new * u0_new = beta_old * v0_old)

source_rows.HighSourceRows: the seven high_* rows: r - k, k - B - r, k(1+c) - r, k(1+d) - r, 2k - r + w - B, -J d B - (r-k)^2, -J c A - (r-k)^2
source_rows.ClosedOuterBox: k >= 2, k <= 21/10, k <= r (the models' closed outer box); highDomain_closedOuter
source_rows.RTangents: the three inherited rational r tangents (r_tangent_1..3)
source_rows.rank_product_decomp_dB: -J B d - (r-k)^2 = (J - chi) d b + (c b - t) d a + t (d a - t), a = -A, b = -B, t = r-k, chi = c a
source_rows.rank_product_decomp_symmetric: -J A c - (r-k)^2 = (J - t) chi + t (chi - t), chi = c a
source_rows.high_rank_product_of_slacks: the row from the archived nonnegative decomposition on the core band (CoreSlacks)

packet_recipes.stagePacket: X: a = (1, x0, x1, x2), b = (p, q0, q1, q2), z = b_j for i = 0 and a_i b_j otherwise
packet_recipes.origPacket: Y: a = (beta, u0, u1, u2), b = (e, v0, v1, v2), the head band p -/+ 1 at (0,0) and the G clamp at (0,0) for type I / (1,0) for type II
packet_recipes.corePacket: C: a = (c, d), b = (k, A, B), z = a_i b_j

realization_bridges.realizes_stage: a box containing the actual source point realizes X with (1, x_i) against (p, q_j)
realization_bridges.realizes_orig: same for Y, both head types, with the package's head rows as the explicit hypothesis HeadRows
realization_bridges.realizes_core: same for C with (c, d) against (k, A, B)
